'''C-3PO''' ('''See-Threepio''') was a [[3PO-series protocol droid]] designed to interact with [[Sentience|organics]], programmed primarily for etiquette and protocol. Sometimes referred to as '''Threepio''', he was fluent in over six million forms of [[Language|communication]], and developed a fussy and worry-prone personality throughout his many [[Time|decades]] of operation. Along with his counterpart, the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], C-3PO constantly found himself directly involved in pivotal moments of [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history|history]], and aided in saving the galaxy on many occasions.

C-3PO was rebuilt from spare parts by [[Anakin Skywalker]], an [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[human]] who lived in [[Mos Espa]], a [[city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of [[Tatooine]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], he would serve the [[Naboo]] [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Shortly after the Clone Wars, C-3PO's memory was [[Memory wipe|erased]], though R2-D2's memory was not. C-3PO and R2-D2 were assigned to the [[Alderaan]] [[CR90 corvette|cruiser]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', where they served senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] for nineteen years, assisting in his fledgling [[Bail Organa's resistance movement|resistance movement]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. At some point during this time, C-3PO's right leg was fitted with mismatched plating.

C-3PO remained constant companions with R2, and in [[1 BBY]], the pair became embroiled in the [[Galactic Civil War]] when [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] entrusted them to bring a copy of the [[Death Star plans]] to the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Tatooine. After meeting Skywalker's son, [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], the droids helped rescue [[Princess]] Leia from the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. They became directly attached to the three humans, helping them and their rebellion defeat the Empire and restore freedom to the galaxy, most notably when he convinced the [[Ewok]]s to aid the Rebels at the [[Battle of Endor]].

Following the Battle of Endor, C-3PO continued serving the Skywalkers and Solo during the time of the [[New Republic]]. About thirty years after the events on [[Endor]], C-3PO was still an aide to Organa, who had become a [[general]] in the [[Resistance]], a private military group opposed to the [[First Order]], a military junta that emulated the Old Empire. By that time, C-3PO was fitted with a new set of gold plating, which had a more symmetrical design than his previous coverings, with the exception of his head. His new coverings included a third finger joint, and a torso that was not as slim as it used to be. Because of his new plating, he no longer had a mismatched right lower leg. Although, he did end up wearing a red left arm for a very short time. By that time, C-3PO's language database had also been updated so that he could understand and communicate in over seven million different forms of communication, including ancient Sith dialects. He would assist [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] in translating Sith writings in order to locate [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet, the [[Final Order]], on [[Exegol]], allowing his memory to be wiped in order to carry out the task. However, his friend R2 backed up a large portion of his memories, and after the Resistance defeated Sidious and the Sith Eternal in the [[Battle of Exegol]], his memory was restored.
